30 CC0 SFX loops by rubberduck - CC0
40 CC0 water / splash / slime SFX by rubberduck - CC0

amb_red.note: JC Desert Wind: centroid 414 Hz, 64% of energy below 300 Hz, 0.0 onsets/s - broad dusty wind with body and no wildlife. Tilted down for thin air.
amb_red.group: Ambience: the air of a place

amb_forest.note: JC Enchanted Forest: centroid 239 Hz, 0.1 onsets/s - a deep drone with NO bird or insect transients (Forest Day/Pine/Rainforest measured 1-4/s of Earth fauna, wrong planet). Mountain Peak adds air; syn_alien_life adds this world's voices.
amb_forest.group: Ambience: the air of a place

amb_ice.note: JC Winter Wind: centroid 410 Hz, stationarity 0.74 - steady cold wind. Mountain Peak (0.6% below 300 Hz) adds the thin whistle over the peaks; syn_ice_groan puts the frozen lakes under strain.
amb_ice.group: Ambience: the air of a place

amb_suit.note: Synthesised: the helmet fan. Always present, so kept near silent.
amb_suit.group: Ambience: the air of a place

amb_interior.note: JC Fog: centroid 128 Hz, 97% below 300 Hz, flatness 0.000 - a pure low drone. Low-passed hard and given a big room: wind outside the smashed windows, heard from inside a dead building.
amb_interior.group: Ambience: the air of a place

amb_gas_leak.note: rubberduck noise_02: 95.5% above 2 kHz, stationarity 0.87 - a steady hiss. Positioned on the oxygen generator's snapped pipe (fx.vapor).
amb_gas_leak.group: Ambience: the air of a place

spark.note: Synthesised electrical arc. Drawn as solid pixels because additive light vanishes on the white machines; the sound does the same job for the ear.

amb_pool.note: rubberduck loop_bubbles_1: 11.3 onsets/s - a proper burble. Underground River (stationarity 0.88, no transients) puts it in a hollow space.
amb_pool.group: Ambience: the air of a place

amb_spire.note: Synthesised: one slow inharmonic tone breathing with the crystal's glow. Alien, and deliberately not a note.
amb_spire.group: Ambience: the air of a place

amb_dome.note: Synthesised drone + rubberduck ambient_01 (centroid 221 Hz, flatness 0.008 - a real tonal machine hum). Only the powered domes (nursery, comms) get this; the base is dead and silent.
amb_dome.group: Ambience: the air of a place

amb_wreck.note: JC Dying Embers: 5.0 onsets/s, 61% below 300 Hz - crackle with weight, and the right name for a wreck that has been burning a while. fire-1 (centroid 261 Hz) adds the deep pops.
amb_wreck.group: Ambience: the air of a place

amb_lamp.note: Synthesised: a repaired lamp, heard only from right under it.
amb_lamp.group: Ambience: the air of a place

beacon.note: Synthesised double blip, fired in step with the drawn strobe.

step_dust.note: Kenney footstep_grass: 90.6% below 300 Hz - soft and granular, not leafy once the top is tilted off. Reads as boots in deep red dust.

step_moss.note: Kenney footstep_carpet: the most muffled set in the pack. Damp forest moss.

step_snow.note: Corsica_S: real field recordings of single steps on snow over gravel, ~0.6 s each. The authentic crunch - nothing synthesised comes close.

step_metal.note: Kenney footstep_concrete for the hard tile floor, with impactPlate_light underneath for the ring of a metal deck below it.

land_soft.note: Kenney impactSoft_heavy: centroid 61 Hz, 100% below 300 Hz - a pure dull thud. Grit from a footstep on top so it lands in dust.

land_hard.note: The same thud with impactPlate_heavy (95% below 300 Hz) for the drop from height.

slide.note: rubberduck rolling.ogg pitched down: a continuous scrape for skidding down ground too steep to stand on.

tool_unfold.note: Synthesised servo, plate clacks and lock-on, timed to the 18-frame equip animation at 20 fps. Real spring metal on top for bite.

tool_fold.note: The reverse, at the 1.3x the animation plays backwards at.

tool_lens.note: The lens lighting on equip frame 14.

tool_target.note: The job icon appearing over a new target. Near-threshold.

beam_mine.note: Synthesised, gated at the 7 Hz the beam is drawn pulsing at.

beam_gather.note: Synthesised airy updraught for the spiral stream.

beam_fix.note: Synthesised sweep at the 0.8 Hz the scan lines sweep at.

rock_crack.note: Kenney impactMining: made for exactly this, 92% below 300 Hz. Fires as the cracks spread, not continuously.

rock_burst.note: rubberduck rock_breaking (12.7 onsets/s of debris) + impactMining for the low end + a synthesised sub thump, because the camera shakes 2.6 px here.

gather_pop.note: Synthesised chime for the thing vanishing into the lens, with real stone grit so it stays a rock and not a UI noise.

lift_grab.note: Synthesised: the violet tether taking hold.

lift_loop.note: Synthesised thrum while a crate follows you.

lift_drop.note: A cargo crate settling: real wood fall plus a soft heavy thud for the mass.

lamp_on.note: Synthesised: two struggling ticks, then warm light. The first thing in the game you actually fix.

door_unseal.note: rubberduck lock_open (9.5 onsets/s of mechanism) over metal_open and a heavy metal impact: the seal letting go of a door 1.6x the astronaut's height.

door_vent.note: rubberduck air_01: 89.7% above 2 kHz - pressurised air. Shaped to a burst that matches the 28-puff gas cloud the door throws.

door_slide.note: Real sheet metal moving, with a synthesised servo under it: heavy slab, powered mechanism. Looped while the halves travel.

door_close.note: metal_slam over a heavy plate: the door sealing behind you.

door_lamp.note: The amber warning light ticking while the door works.

crash_roar.note: Synthesised re-entry: pressure and tearing in a thin atmosphere.

crash_impact.note: rubberduck thunder_01 (5.3 s, 63.6% below 300 Hz) plus a heavy plate and a synthesised falling sub: the touchdown that shakes the camera 5 px.

crash_skid.note: The satellite ploughing its trench: rolling pitched right down, with the low end of a thunderstorm under it for mass.

debris.note: Real rock falling: what comes down after the impact.

ui_map_open.note: A real switch: the map screen is a physical thing on the suit.

ui_map_close.note: The same switch, the other way.

ui_room.note: A room name fading in on the toast plate.
